geographic_priority.scope: City agencies and city-controlled public records.
County agencies and county-controlled public records relevant to the local study area.
Public entities in the adjacent regional corridor; individual agencies are added only after source verification.
Statewide and federal records only where they identify, fund, regulate, or otherwise directly document the local/regional entities or programs under review.

collection_tracks: agency training, policies, and publicly released curricula
public-agency procurement, contractors, and contract amendments
publicly disclosed claims, settlements, judgments, and payouts
federal, state, and local grants, awards, appropriations, and funding flows, including VAWA-related programs when the official record supports that classification

public-office and justice-system accountability records: judges, law-enforcement agencies and officers, prosecutors, public defenders, court staff, and other public officials, limited to official role records and final/publicly released oversight, discipline, ethics, licensing, court, or administrative outcomes
evidence_rules: Use primary public records or official government datasets as the record of fact whenever available.
Retain the source URL, publisher, retrieval time, record identifier, and a content hash or archived file reference when lawfully obtainable.
Separate an agency's statement, an award record, a contract record, and an independently verified payment record; do not treat one as proof of another.
Do not infer a relationship, misconduct, funding purpose, contractor role, or payment outcome from shared names, locations, or timing alone.
Do not collect private personal information, victim information, protected personnel information, sealed material, or content unavailable to the general public.
Mark unverified leads as leads; they are not evidence records and must not be presented as findings.
Record explicit scope limits, missing periods, and known source limitations with each dataset.

For an individual public official, record only role-relevant information from an official government, court, licensing, or disciplinary source; do not publish home addresses, personal contact details, family information, protected identifiers, or other private information.

Do not assign a score, grade, risk label, or “report card” conclusion. Present dated, cited records and their official disposition; a reader may inspect the sources without the corpus implying character, competence, or culpability.

A complaint, allegation, lawsuit, investigation, charge, or news report must be labeled by procedural status and must not be presented as substantiated unless a cited official final disposition says so.

For judicial officers, lawyers, and law-enforcement personnel, distinguish an agency action, licensing/disciplinary action, judicial decision, settlement, dismissal, and pending matter. Never collapse them into one outcome.
out_of_scope: Private, sensitive, sealed, or otherwise nonpublic personal data
Attempts to obtain nonpublic systems, credentials, or restricted records
Conclusions about individual or organizational liability absent a cited public record establishing that conclusion
Doxxing or publishing personal contact, household, family, protected, sealed, juvenile, victim, or otherwise nonpublic information
Subjective ratings, rankings, or “report cards” about identifiable people
collection_status: foundation-only; no public-record claim dataset has been populated by this file
